tasks.title: Choose the next step without running it: flags, the environment and the dry run
steps: Add the behaviours as tests and confirm they fail: the flag and environment tables, the dry run, nothing open and nothing able to start. Add the fixture helpers they need to one helpers file of internal/specrun: a git repository with a bare origin and packages copied from afspec/testdata

Move the choice of the next package out of cmd/speca/next.go into afspec as an exported function that reads the spec root and returns the next package, whether everything is done, the packages that wait with their reasons, and a cycle as an error; it needs what cmd/speca and internal/specpkg hold today about a finished, an open and a legacy package, so move that with it. `speca --next` calls the function and its output and tests stay as they are
Add github.com/agent-fox-dev/aflib to go.mod at a pseudo-version of its main branch, and use only its envelope package here

Add the package internal/specrun and the command cmd/specrun, whose main only calls it. Neither imports internal/cli, internal/specpkg, specgen or anything else that depends on agentkit-go: flag parsing is the standard library's

Parse the flags --max, --stall, --log-dir, --strict-skills, --dry-run, --ledger, --reset-state and --version, each default taken from its SPECRUN_ variable when set; refuse unknown flags, positional arguments, values a flag cannot hold and two of --dry-run, --ledger and --reset-state together, as usage errors with exit code 2

Write the answer as one aflib envelope with tool specrun and a result holding landed, all_done, waiting, stopped, dry_run, next_step and versions; exit code 0 when the loop ended on its own, 1 when it stopped or failed, 2 for a usage error
Implement --dry-run: ask afspec for the next package and report it, or the waiting packages, without switching a branch, pulling, or writing state or logs
done_when: `go list -deps ./cmd/specrun` names no package of agentkit-go

tasks.title: Run a session for the next package and check that it landed
steps: Add the fake claude: a small main package under internal/specrun's test data that the tests build once and put first on PATH, driven by a script file an environment variable names. Add the loop's behaviours as tests and confirm they fail

Before every step switch to the base branch, which is the branch refs/remotes/origin/HEAD names, else main, and pull it with --ff-only; a failure of either, and a missing claude or git, stop the run at stage preflight before any session
Start the session with the command line the first criterion gives, in the repository, with CLAUDE_CODE_PRINT_BG_WAIT_CEILING_MS set to the stall time in milliseconds, in a process group of its own

When the session ends, whatever its exit code, check that the base branch is checked out, the tree is clean, HEAD is not the commit it was before the step, and the package has no task pending or in progress, read through afspec; the first check that fails stops the loop and is named in result.stopped
Go on to the next step until nothing is open, nothing can start or --max packages have landed in this run
Keep stdout for the one envelope: a session's output never reaches it, and each step writes one line to stderr

tasks.title: Save every session's stream, keep the ledger and end a session that stalls
steps: Add the behaviours as tests and confirm they fail: the two files per step, the ledger line with a stubbed clock, the median warning table, the ledger table, the refused log directories and the stall

Resolve the log directory: --log-dir, else agent-fox/specrun/<repository name> under the user's cache directory; refuse one inside the working tree as a usage error and one that cannot be written at stage preflight

Read the session's stdout line by line as it arrives; append each line to <step>.jsonl, where <step> is the four-digit number of the step in this ledger, its kind and its subject; when the session ends write the result text of its last event of type result to <step>.log
Restart a timer at every line; when it reaches --stall, signal the session's process group, wait for it to end, record the step as stalled and stop the loop

Append one JSON line per step to ledger.jsonl with kind, subject, started_at, ended_at, wall_minutes and outcome; print it in short form on stderr, and a warning line when a landed package took more than twice the median wall minutes of the packages landed before it in the ledger
Implement --ledger: print the ledger as a text table on stdout, skipping lines that do not parse, and start nothing

tasks.title: Keep the state file and resume from it
steps: Add the behaviours as tests and confirm they fail: the state copied mid-session, the resume table, --reset-state, and the refused starts

Write the state after every change, through a temporary file renamed over <repository name>.json under agent-fox/specrun in the state directory ($XDG_STATE_HOME, else ~/.local/state): the steps done, and the running step with its kind, subject, started_at, the commit HEAD was at and the process id of specrun
At start read the file. Refuse one that does not parse, naming --reset-state, and one whose running step records a process id of a live specrun

For a running implement step: when the package has no open task and the base branch has moved past the recorded commit, write its ledger line as landed and go on; when its feature branch exists, or nothing can be told, run the step again for the same package; when the package no longer exists, drop the step and choose anew
Implement --reset-state: remove the file, report it, and start nothing

tasks.title: Say what runs, install the command, document it and retire the script
steps: Add the behaviours as tests and confirm they fail: the versions with the skill in the user's and the project's directory, the warning table and --strict-skills

At start find the af-impl SKILL.md a session here loads, the project's .claude/skills copy before the user's, hash it with SHA-256, run `claude --version` and `issue --version`, log all of it on stderr and put it in result.versions; a missing issue is 'not installed'

Compare the hash with the one the build embedded: warn skill_mismatch or skill_not_installed and go on, or with --strict-skills refuse at stage preflight; with no embedded hash report unknown, warn nothing, and refuse under --strict-skills

In the Makefile, make build install ./cmd/specrun beside the other three commands and pass the linker the SHA-256 of the af-impl SKILL.md as internal/skillgen renders it for the agent claude from skills/, and the same Version, Commit and BuildTime the others get

Write docs/specrun.md in the style of docs/speca.md: the loop, the landing checks, every flag and its SPECRUN_ variable, the state file and resume, the stall, the log directory and the ledger, the result and the exit codes, every sample copied from a test or the command's output; link it from docs/cli.md; add the command and internal/specrun to docs/architecture.md, the variables and directories to docs/configuration.md, and the afspec function to docs/api.md

Record the decision in a new ADR under docs/adr with the next free number, drive-the-implementation-loop-with-specrun: a Go driver on afspec and aflib, claude -p as the only model runtime, state in one JSON file, sessions checked and not trusted
Delete scripts/impl-specs.sh, and name specrun in the README and in every document that names the script
Run `make doc` and commit docs/generated
done_when: `go list -deps ./cmd/specrun` names no package of agentkit-go
